title: Tool 66 — RWA Tokenization Cost Model
description: 5-year TCO model for tokenizing real-world assets vs. traditional settlement. Compare bond, MMF, repo, and trade receivable tokenization costs across Corda, Canton, Fabric, and public EVM. Break-even analysis. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.
